title: File upload with size and type checks
tasks: file upload with size and type checks

requirements.text: The server enforces the size limit while streaming and rejects oversized bodies (413) without buffering them
The server detects the type from the file's bytes, not only its extension or declared Content-Type
Only allowlisted types are accepted, and the detected type must agree with the extension
Original filenames are sanitized and cannot traverse paths or use reserved names
The client rejects files over the size limit or outside the allowlist before uploading
Only authorized users upload into their own tenant, within a quota
Files stay quarantined until scanned before they are served
Uploads are served as attachments with nosniff, or from a separate origin

evidence.name: upload rejects a declared Content-Length over the limit with too-large before reading and cancels the stream
upload counts streamed bytes without Content-Length and stops reading at the limit with too-large
sniffType detects png, jpeg, gif, webp, pdf, zip and plain text from magic bytes, and flags svg and html markup
type allowlist: detected type must agree with the extension and the declared type; unlisted types are refused
svg and html are rejected by default even when renamed, and need allowActiveContent to be allowlisted
sanitizeFilename strips traversal, control and bidi characters, renames Windows reserved names and caps the length
upload stores bytes under a random storage key, never the original name
preflight rejects oversize, empty, unlisted, mismatched and badly named files on File-like objects before upload
authorize gates uploads per tenant and an unauthorized user cannot read or delete another tenant's file
concurrent uploads cannot exceed the tenant quota and failed uploads release their reservation
concurrent uploads on PostgreSQL cannot exceed the tenant quota (atomic reservation)
uploads start quarantined; only files the scanner marks clean are served; infected files are deleted
conditional status changes and deletes on PostgreSQL: infected bytes are released once and stale verdicts change nothing
HTTP: download serves attachment with RFC 6266 filename*, nosniff, the stored detected type and a sandbox CSP

implementations.notes: No antivirus engine: scanning is an injected hook and files stay quarantined until a verdict. Bytes are held in memory up to maxBytes before BlobStore.put.

evidence.name: file signatures match the shared vectors

implementations.notes: Metadata-only check; its test exercises the extension rejection but not the size limit
tusd hooks reserve quota and check ownership; tested inside the pack, not in tests/

notes: module:file-uploads covers streaming size limits, sniffing, allowlists, quotas, quarantine and safe serving. The app supplies the antivirus scanner and object storage behind the BlobStore interface.
